name: vscode-notist
description: .not knowledge-base support for VS Code: syntax highlighting, language server (diagnostics, completion, navigation) and live preview, powered by `notist lsp`.

notist.server.command.markdownDescription: Command used to launch the language server. Must ultimately run `notist lsp` (the `lsp` subcommand is appended automatically). Whitespace-separated, so wrapper commands like `nix run .#notist --` work via this field plus `#notist.server.args#`.

notist.server.args.markdownDescription: Extra arguments inserted between the command and the `lsp` subcommand (whitespace-separated). For example `--no-daemon` to keep the server in embedded mode.

notist.preview.debounceMs.description: Debounce applied to re-rendering the preview while typing.

notist.preview.scrollPreviewWithEditor.markdownDescription: Scroll the preview as the editor scrolls (element-accurate via the renderer's `data-notist-start` offsets).

notist.preview.scrollEditorWithPreview.markdownDescription: Scroll the editor as the preview scrolls (viewport only — no cursor or focus changes).

notist.preview.clickToSource.markdownDescription: Click in the preview to jump to the corresponding source position.
